# ONLYOFFICE Docs: Office API

> Use our JavaScript library to build plugins, macros, and scripts across all document types: documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and forms.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page, except those to a further llms.txt: the full index of the pages under that entry. For the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/llms.txt).

## Get started

- [Overview](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/get-started/overview.md): Office API allows you to insert content into a document and format it to your liking quickly and easily. Any document is a composite object: a tree of larger nodes (paragraphs and tables) into which you can insert smaller document elements (text runs, images, charts, shapes).
- [Playground](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/get-started/playground.md): The Playground serves as an interactive platform for users to explore and test the capabilities of the ONLYOFFICE Docs APIs without registration and installing anything. It provides users with various API functionalities, allowing them to experiment with different document types seamlessly.

## API usage

- [Document API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/llms.txt): Although a document consists of various elements, most of them are nested in each other and three main elements can be outlined: paragraph, table and block content control. All the other elements are a part of these three larger ones.
- [Spreadsheet API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/llms.txt): A spreadsheet document has a more simple structure than that of a document, most of the spreadsheet elements are nested within the worksheet element with all the other elements placed on it.
- [Presentation API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/llms.txt): A presentation document has a more simple structure than that of a document, most of the presentation elements are nested within the slide element with all the other elements placed on it. The single or multiple slide elements are a part of the presentation element.
- [Form API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/form-api/llms.txt): A form document has exactly the same structure as a document. The only difference is a new forms entity placed with other paragraph elements – text runs, inline text content controls and hyperlinks. There are seven form types: text field, combo box, dropdown list, checkbox, radio button, picture form, and complex field.
- [PDF API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/llms.txt): A PDF document is organized as a sequence of pages. Each page can contain several types of content: paragraphs, tables, drawings (images, shapes, charts), annotations, and interactive form fields.

- [Adding date and company footer](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/samples/document-editor/adding-date-company-footer.md): Create a footer with a company name and current date.
